info.title: FACIS FAP PCI ORCE API
info.description: HTTP contract preserved from Sprint Review 1 while implementation runs entirely in ORCE flows and uibuilder. Provider and tenant administration use Keycloak-backed server sessions. Paths remain application-relative; the deployment prefix is supplied by PCI_ORCE_BASE_PATH.

servers.description: Deployment-specific PCI main host plus the normalized public ORCE HTTP base path.

basePath.description: Normalized PCI_ORCE_BASE_PATH. Empty means root; examples include /BASE and /platform/orce.

sr2Internal.description: Operator-managed internal service token plus exact source IP allowlist; public-route marker denied. Exact upstream callback identity contract is additionally required.

sr2Session.name: fap_pci_session
sr2Session.description: Verified Keycloak-backed session. Routed tenant and enabled membership plus current assignment are checked server-side.

orceBasePath.description: Canonical normalized PCI_ORCE_BASE_PATH; empty means root.

redirectUri.description: Exact server-derived host plus canonical base path and /ui/.

orceBasePath.description: Canonical normalized PCI_ORCE_BASE_PATH; empty means root.

configurationIds.description: Administrator-controlled live authorization: null allows any tenant configuration; IDs restrict access; absent or empty denies all. Changes apply immediately, including pinned requests.

base64.description: PNG 8-bit RGB/RGBA, no interlace, <=1024x1024; server decodes and re-encodes.

configurationIds.description: null grants all configurations and creation rights; a list grants only those configurations.

credentialId.description: Verified JWT jti or VC id; null if not recorded. Never a synthesized request identifier.

currentState.description: Latest locally confirmed request state, not a live upstream status check.
